GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length 3 Wide , in Two Wide entering first turn, crossed middle stages, railed up to 1.5 Lengths turning, shifted Two Wide at 400m, looked to shift around leader's heels at 220m, swicthed back Two Wide as leader drifted wider, Made Ground to the line but veered onto the rail at the 50m chopping out runner 3rd over line, hit Lead 30m from post. First over the line. Demoted to 3rd on protest. [Stewards: Rider reported it laid in under pressure in straight.] # demoted on protest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported gelding lay in when under pressure in the home straight. Relegated from 1st to 3rd place after being unsuccessful in protest.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Made Ground middle stages, Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, hooked out to centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line. (Winkers FIRST TIME) # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1100m bumped and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Fractious in the barrier, dwelt and missed start 1 length , Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, dropped out in Straight # slow out/no threat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was slow to begin as a result.
